name: Steak, Bell Pepper & Apricot Skewers with Creamy Cucumber-Mint Salad

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: If using wooden skewers, place 12-18 skewers in a shallow dish of water to soak until you are ready to use them.
Place yogurt, oil, and spices in a large bowl; whisk to combine the marinade.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup plain Greek yogurt
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp cumin, ground
1 tbsp paprika
1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Cut steak into 1-inch cubes, add to the bowl with the marinade along with the apricots and stir to coat; set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg striploin (New York strip) steak
36 dried apricots

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small pkg fresh mint
1 ½ English cucumbers
3 red bell peppers

instructions.primary_message: Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and, using a clean cutting board, mince the leaves. Place half in a medium bowl (reserving the rest for garnish).
Add yogurt, oil, and salt to the bowl with the mint and whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup plain Greek yogurt
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Trim, halve, and slice cucumbers crosswise into thin half-moons; add to the bowl with the dressing and stir to combine the salad. Set aside.
Peel, halve, and cut onions into 1½-inch wide pieces. Trim, seed, and cut bell peppers into 1½-inch pieces. Add both to the bowl with the steak and apricots; stir to coat.

Thread steak, apricots, onion, and bell pepper onto skewers, alternating ingredients; place on a plate. (If you don't have skewers, you can cook the steak, apricots, and veggies directly on the grill pan.)
Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the grill pan is hot, coat with oil; working in batches if necessary, add the skewers and cook, turning occasionally, until the steak is cooked through and veggies are fork-tender, 8-10 minutes. Remove to a clean plate.
To serve, divide skewers and salad between plates; sprinkle with reserved mint and enjoy!
